# Empty Sections in Technical Documents

Some nuclear materials science papers contain empty or nearly-empty sections between substantive content blocks. The lattice constant of UO2 is 5.4704 angstrom.

# Results

The bulk modulus of UO2 is 207.5 GPa. The melting point is 3120 K. The thermal conductivity at 500 K is 6.0 W/(m K). The density is 10.97 g/cm^3.
